_comment: Index of deliverables built from the vault. `file` is the in-repo copy under artifacts/ (the source of truth); `url` is the live Claude Artifact. tools/build_artifacts_index.py renders artifacts/index.html (a real web page — links work, unlike inside a sandboxed artifact). tools/vault_health.py renders the same list on the PRIVATE health dashboard only (several titles name product surfaces, so it never reaches the public page). Hand-maintained: Claude has no API to enumerate artifacts. Items with no `file` have no in-repo copy yet (couldn't be re-fetched); the hub falls back to their live url.
